يتهادوا (form VI)
# يَتَهَادَوْا (yatahādaw) /ja.ta.haː.daw/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَهَادَى (tahādā)
# يُتَهَادَوْا (yutahādaw) /ju.ta.haː.daw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَهَادَى (tahādā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
